title: Evaluation of the bundled symplectic form
statement:
Fix a prime $p$ and an integer $n$, and set $V = \bbf_p^n \times \bbf_p^n$, equipped with the alternating bilinear form
\[
\omega\big((x,z),(x',z')\big) \;=\; \sum_{i=1}^{n}\big(x_i z'_i - z_i x'_i\big),
\qquad (x,z),(x',z') \in V.
\]
Let $B \colon V \times V \to \bbf_p$ be the bilinear form on $V$ obtained by bundling $\omega$. Then $B$ agrees with $\omega$ on every pair of arguments: for all $u, v \in V$ one has $B(u,v) = \omega(u,v)$.
hypotheses_covered: u, v range over V = F_p^n × F_p^n
B is the bilinear form obtained by bundling ω
replaced:
The bundled bilinear form $\mathrm{symB}$ agrees with $\omega$:
$\mathrm{symB}(x,y) = \omega(x,y)$ for all $x,y \in V$.
